name: pdf2md-webui
description: Web UIs for pdf2md — validator (now) and viewer (later). Kept fully separate from the pdf2md Python package; no Python imports.

scripts.build: npm --workspace shared run build && npm run stage-data && npm --workspace validator run build
scripts.build:pages: npm --workspace shared run build && npm run stage-data && VITE_BASE=/pdf2md/ npm --workspace validator run build && cp validator/dist/index.html validator/dist/404.html
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace shared run typecheck && npm --workspace validator run typecheck
